title: Cross-Industry TBM (Tool Box Meeting) Record — Shared Base
description: Shared base evidence model for pre-work Tool Box Meetings (TBM, 작업 전 안전점검회의) across high-risk industries. Domain-specific fields go in industry_specific_fields. Construction retains its dedicated ehsconst-tbm-record.json for construction-only provisions (SAPA Art.5, contractor tier).

industry_profile.description: Industry profile determines the legal_basis template and industry_specific_fields schema

presenter_id.description: TBM 진행자 ID (safety officer or supervisor)

attendee_refs.description: Structured attendee list — worker IDs or TRAIN-* training-record.json references (attendance traceability)

makeup_training_ref.description: Reference to the training-record.json instance (TRAIN-*) covering absentees' make-up briefing (결근자 별도교육); required when absentees_follow_up=true

risk_assessment_ref.description: Reference to the applicable 위험성평가 (risk assessment) record per OSHA-KR Article 36 discussed in this TBM

permit_to_work_ref.description: Reference to the associated Permit-to-Work (PTW) record if this TBM precedes a PTW-governed task

industry_specific_fields.description: Domain-specific extension fields (e.g., {voltage_class: '25kV'} for railway, {gas_type: 'LNG'} for gasterm, {explosive_class: 'Class 1.1'} for defense)

legal_basis.description: Multi-source legal basis. Must cite >= 3 regulatory sources. Common base: OSHA-KR Articles 15/17 (safety management), Article 36 (risk assessment), Article 38 (safety measures). Industry-specific additions per the workflow's legal_basis template. SAPA Article 4 or Article 5/7 as applicable.
examples: 고압가스 안전 관리 및 사업법 Art.17
